plugin.name: Bend2
plugin.description:
Language support for Bend 2 in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Syntax highlighting, hash line comments, and editable snippets
  • Completion, parameter information, parameter hints, constructor-case generation, and explicit imports
  • Go to Declaration, Go to Symbol, Find Usages, static dependency inspection, and source Quick Documentation
  • Manual and optional background compiler checking of unsaved source and imports
  • Selectable proof roots, law/fill navigation, proof progress, Run and Build configurations
  • Foreign source paths, previewable file refactoring, templates, and optional IDE spelling assistance
Editing works without a Bend installation. Configure a Bend compiler to use checking and compiler-backed features. See the README for setup and current limitations.
plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.1.17:

  • Pin explicitly requested compiler-normalized values beside expressions, with automatic stale-result removal and visible unsafe/foreign reliance.
  • Accept compatible tooling protocols independently of Bend release numbers, retaining check-only CLI fallback when optional helper operations are unavailable.
  • Preserve lambda binding identity through typed local-let continuations for completion, navigation and rename.
  • Respect Bend grouping when expanding selections over glued less-than comparisons.
  • Add offline Quick Documentation for 25 Bend syntax tokens, including incomplete and unsaved code.
  • Upgrade reproducible compiler tests and the optional structured helper to Bend 2.0.35 with Bun 1.4.2.
